nodes.text:
🚨Rising Cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV)

The Federal Government of Nigeria is stepping up surveillance for inbound passengers from China following a surge in Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases, particularly affecting kids under 14 years old.
#HealthAwareness
@aproko_doctor https://t.co/nLAYDppms8

nodes.author: Pharm_Obi
nodes.text: HMPV, a respiratory virus, has caused overcrowded hospitals and public concern in northern Chinese provinces this winter. While neighboring countries like Taiwan, Cambodia, and Hong Kong report isolated cases, China has implemented stringent measures, including mask mandates,

nodes.author: Pharm_Obi
nodes.text:
social distancing, and public space disinfection.

Nigerian authorities, led by the NCDC, are activating quarantine protocols and other precautions to safeguard public health. Stay informed and adhere to preventive measures as we monitor the situation.
#HMPV #Healthtips #Health
